cuts.label: xqc@momentkawaiiinterestingsnoodblargnaut-jm2ztv9rqcc_xv36/xqc-delivery-jean-2026w38
cuts.title: xQc plugs in a mystery dongle mid-stream and loses his GTA inventory
cuts.hook: A courier hands xQc a package
cuts.retelling: A courier hands xQc a package meant for his GTA RP character, and when he plugs in the green dongle inside, his game crashes and he comes back to find his crowbar and loot gone.

cuts.label: scout:buddha+xqc/buddha-xqc-anoth-charact-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc told everyone to buy Snack. Then it crashed
cuts.hook: xQc told everyone to buy Snack
cuts.retelling: xQc hyped an in-game coin called Snack and told viewers to buy, then Buddha watched it crash to $13 and lost $800, and xQc later said the guy behind it rug pulled everyone.

cuts.label: alinity@vod2870474986/alinity-backbend-does-2026w37
cuts.title: Alinity's Workout Gets Crashed By Her Dog Loki
cuts.retelling: Alinity does a risky handstand and a backbend during a stream, and her dog Loki wanders in, blocks the camera and ends up on her face.

cuts.label: lirik@vod2819877479/lirik-about-slith-2026w29
cuts.title: Lirik thinks Slither.io lobby planned it on Discord
cuts.retelling: Lirik tries to sit out a Slither.io round by staying idle, a giant snake runs him down, and in a later round a pack of snakes kills him and he complains they had a planned attack.

cuts.label: kaicenat@momentsquarealertlionpraiseit-o0c5aserkk1e3bxk/kaicenat-about-asks-2026w29
cuts.title: Kai the Dean demands a student name names, then throws her out of his office
cuts.hook: Dean Kai demands Lina name who she's
cuts.retelling: In a Streamer University skit, Dean Kai grills student Lina about who she is 'stitching' on, she begs that she can't say, then asks to play something and falls off her stool, and Kai throws her out of his office.

cuts.label: erobb221@momentpeacefulclumsycattlebrainslug-trabc44bje5ieuld/erobb221-carrot-costume-2026w41
cuts.title: Erobb's partner picks his costume and it's a carrot
cuts.retelling: A streamer wears a carrot costume his partner picked, says the joke is funny for ten seconds and then stupid, and complains about how annoying the costume is while still wearing it.

cuts.label: scout:jynxzi/jynxzi-death-into-2026w41
cuts.title: 'I fell through a tiny hole': Jynxzi's hardcore Minecraft argument
cuts.retelling: Jynxzi's teammate dies twice in a hardcore Minecraft run and Jynxzi accuses him of trolling both times, ending with 'you got paid', but the teammate's side and any real answer are never shown.

cuts.label: xqc@momentmoldycleanwaterwoofer--jwekx3tcmffxe9r/xqc-charact-clayton-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc robs a clerk, finds an antique gun, and gets warned
cuts.hook: xQc's robber finds the clerk's antique gun
cuts.retelling: A masked robber in a GTA roleplay server takes an antique gun from a clerk who warns him about it, and later his friends tell him off because someone got shot, though the shooting itself is never shown.
